svg.title: Project repositories
svg.desc: Private repositories behind Project Reborn RP. RebornRP: the server monorepo with 230+ resources, four asset submodules, written in Lua, TypeScript, JavaScript and SQL, repo created in October 2024. Asset submodules: Reborn-Design-Vehicles: Civilian, police, EMS, fire and security fleets, wheels and paints.; Reborn-Design-Clothing: Civilian, police, EMS and business uniforms and outfits.; Reborn-Design-Maps: Curated MLOs, interiors, terrain and map fixes for the city.; Reborn-Design-Weapons: Weapon models and skins, plus the Reborn pickaxes and axes.
